notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]Patch Notes - Demo Update[/b][/h1][p]This update addresses several smaller issues reported since the demo launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor visual and interaction bugs resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Small gameplay inconsistencies corrected[/p][/*][*][p]General stability improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Development is also ongoing on a major rework of the movement system, which will be the focus of the next significant update.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shared feedback - your reviews are very helpful as the game continues to improve.[/p]
